name: Data Quality Assessment
publication_holds: Absence-of-external-review hold: one Claude Sonnet and one Grok attempt for WM-DAT-007 each timed out after 120 seconds; no external research result was admitted.
Relation hold: the WM-DAT-001 parent signal and incoming candidate COMPOSE relation are not approved frozen composition edges and grant no ownership, mutation or cascade behavior.
Purpose hold: fitness, importance, thresholds, weighting, aggregation and acceptance depend on the declared consumer, use case, decision, subject version, population and time.
Method hold: sampling frame, coverage, bias, missingness, reference values, measurement error, uncertainty and reproducibility require domain-qualified methods.
Conformance hold: passing a schema, shape, rule or validation run does not prove universal correctness, completeness, quality, safety or absence of harm.

Authority hold: production-data mutation, contract changes, pipeline execution, threshold changes, access widening, certification, issue closure, remediation execution, publication and records disposition require delegated authority.
Privacy hold: personal or sensitive source data, row-level violations, proprietary rules, protected evidence and unpublished verdicts require purpose-bound access and minimization.
Restricted-source hold: ISO/IEC 25012, ISO/IEC 25024, ISO 8000-8 and ISO 19157-1 were used only at public metadata or preview level; access-restricted clauses were not inspected or inferred.
Interoperability hold: DQV, DCAT, PROV, SHACL, JSON Schema, SSN, ISO, UN, OECD, NIST, QUDT, OWL-Time and RFC projections require release pins, conformance tests and information-loss declarations.
Independent external review was explicitly waived by the repository owner; this codex-only result remains a reviewable draft.
